findings.claim: The team documentation still presents the removed `fhir-ideation-strategist` and `fhir-knowledge-curator` as active personas after the required merges.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria require "Fold ideation into the architect and knowledge curation into the tech lead," but the added `Persona → KBD stage and skill matrix` still has rows for `fhir-ideation-strategist` and `fhir-knowledge-curator`, and the hand-off diagram still routes work to both removed roles.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the persona matrix and hand-off diagram to remove `fhir-ideation-strategist` and `fhir-knowledge-curator`, moving their responsibilities and skills to `fhir-architect` and `fhir-tech-lead` respectively.
